rationale: Root hub of the NBS statistics tree; best single monitoring entry point for all Slovak banking/payment series.
EN mirror of the statistics portal; near-parity coverage and needed for sk<->en term mapping.
OpenStats is NBS's machine-friendly open-data layer with a growing dataset roster; standalone and continuously producing.
Authoritative MFI/banking statistics series with monthly releases back to 1998; core sizing backbone.
Curated long time-series export of headline banking indicators; recurring, distinct product.
Recurring monetary-statistics analytical overview; catches definitional breaks in the MFI series.
MIR interest-rate statistics released regularly; in-scope banking market economics.
Recurring money-sector overview release; early headline signal ahead of full datasets.
SIPS operator statistics: densest NBS-created retail payment transaction series, daily/monthly since 2003.
TARGET national settlement statistics; complements SIPS for full Slovak payment traffic picture.
Narrative payment-cards explainer with occasional headline figures; covered by monitoring the NBS payments tree.
Static SK-language glossary of card/ATM/POS definitions; useful anchor but not a signal-producing source.
Recurring Statistical Bulletin with published release schedule; citable consolidated snapshot.
Monthly bulletin with statistical annexes; steady cadence of narrative and revision signals.
Data release calendar lets collection be scheduled to actual release dates; operationally decisive.
SDDS Plus national summary page: standardised macro-financial headers with committed timeliness.
Queryable macro time-series database updated per release; NBS's data-warehouse front end.
Public documentation layer of the reporting portal reveals which card/terminal fields NBS collects; submission side authenticated but docs are open.
Methodology notes needed to interpret breaks and scope changes over a multi-year horizon.
Code lists and entity registers provide the join keys linking series to licensed institutions.
Legal-framework reference within the statistics tree; slow-changing context, covered by the parent.
Financial-stability analytical dataset channel exposing sector aggregates absent from the main tree.
Legally mandated supervisory-disclosure aggregates; distinct recurring prudential view of the banking sector.
ECB Data Portal is the practical machine-readable channel for NBS-reported card/ATM/POS series via API.
Single half-yearly press release instance; the ECB payments-statistics release series is better tracked via the portal parent.
One-off legacy annual-report PDF; valuable historical payment-system tables but a static artifact, mine once for backfill.
Master index of all NBS publication series; best snowball root for the narrative layer on payments and cash.
Annual Report series carries dedicated cash-circulation and payment-systems chapters each year.
Semi-annual Financial Stability Report; recurring analysis of banking and retail-payment trends.
